claims: No. 2 seed Purdue defeated No. 7 seed Miami 79-69 on March 22, 2026, in the NCAA Tournament Round of 32.
Purdue advanced to their third straight Sweet 16.
Purdue's defense held Miami to 36.7% shooting in the second half.
CJ Cox scored 11 points for Purdue.
Purdue's CJ Cox left the game early in the second half with a knee injury.
Purdue's CJ Cox later returned to the bench.
Purdue advances to the Sweet 16 in San Jose, California.
Purdue will face No. 11 seed Texas in the Sweet 16.
Purdue head coach Matt Painter secured his 500th win at the school with this victory
